:::{#def-question}
#### Question

Let $X$ be a [discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv),
and let $\srcalph$ be the set of its [values](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-realization)
with positive [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability).
A **question** about $X$ is a collection of nonempty, disjoint subsets of $\srcalph$ whose union is $\srcalph$,
called its **possible answers**,
so that the events $\{X \in C\}$, one for each possible answer $C$,
form a [partition](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-partition) of the sample space.

:::
